items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: Well, Elmer Jones and Augusta Jones was the owner of all those shows.

ctx.x: I think I've seen the Cole Brothers Circus from the last year.

Then the Jones Brothers and Wilson Circus of 30 Cars. Well, Elmer Jones and Augusta Jones was the owner of all those shows. Three circuses and three outstanding minstrel attractions. And they were fine shows. There was no disgrace to belong to one of them. They had big bands. The band on the Virginia minstrels was conducted by, uh, Frank Moreland, the father of Mantaan. And Frank Moreland was a wonderful bandmaster. The band on the Virginia minstrels was conducted by Ayers first. And, uh, uh, then later on by,…
And? Tell us a little bit about the Georgia Smart Set, because this is a very close friend. I had Buck Johnson, who I remember.
